Collaboration is not social scoring.No credits for conformity, identity, sentiment or friendliness. Conversation does not have to earn its place.

Starting allowance: 20 demo credits. Pool: 100. Nothing is minted by burning a hash. All awards move from the pool; total demo credits stay at 120.

Zero-data gate

Only trusted synthetic modules run. Raw-data requests are rejected before metric evaluation; no raw media or sensor readings are captured, and conversation is not rewarded.

Burn is not eligibility

Revocation leaves the digest intact. A double return needs an admission-bound host-fault fixture plus a recorded demo review. A selected reason is not enough.

One terminal outcome

Stake refund plus a success bonus, ordinary refund, or eligible fault compensation. Bonus and compensation never combine; a digest cannot settle twice in this sandbox.

Reserve → check → settle

NOT ADMITTED

These editable examples lock for the sandbox after its first reservation. The pool protects max(stake, bonus) before admission. Work checks do not themselves move credits.

    Choose a module to beginReserve a refundable admission stake. The preview protects the maximum pool liability before work begins.
    Inspect the module digest and latest local receipt

    The digest covers normalized algorithm, boundary, dataset and claim descriptors, not the module name. SHA-256 binds record contents; it does not prove truth or independence. The prototype policy version is bound to every receipt, but this is not the released receipt format.

    No digest yet

    Reserve a module to create a local record.
    Read the revised credit and burn rules

    Success: refundable stake + the fixed usage bonus. Rejection or voluntary withdrawal: stake only. Reviewed host-fault burn: stake + equal compensation, with no success bonus. Hash history survives every burn.

    Compensation is bounded by the protected pool reserve. It cannot be granted by choosing a reason alone. Repeated settlement of a digest is blocked within this sandbox. Reset or reload starts a fresh simulation, not a funded account.

    Revoke admission. Preserve the hash.

    The topology admission can be burned without earning compensation. A refund decision is a separate rule-bound step.

    No fault evidence recorded.

    10 held credits, two different meaningsOrdinary refund: 10 returned, no gain. Eligible fault: 10 refund + 10 compensation = 20 returned; net compensation is 10. The compensation comes from protected pool funds.

    A fixture review is local simulated evidence, not an independent adjudicator. Real credits require independent fault assessment, durable admission records, anti-replay and a funded compensation policy.
